content: eBay OAuth Client Credentials Grant: POST to https://api.ebay.com/identity/v1/oauth2/token (production) or https://api.sandbox.ebay.com/identity/v1/oauth2/token (sandbox), header Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded, header Authorization: Basic <base64(client_id:client_secret)>, body grant_type=client_credentials&scope=https://api.ebay.com/oauth/api_scope. Response is JSON with access_token, token_type, expires_in (~7200s). No refresh_token for this grant type - just request a new token before expiry.
